title: Unique Paths
description:
A robot starts at the top-left corner of an `m x n` grid and wants to reach the bottom-right corner. It can only move **down** or **right** one cell at a time.

Return the number of distinct paths the robot can take.
constraints: The answer fits in a 32-bit integer for the given inputs.
hints: A single row of state is enough. There is also a closed form using combinations.
